text_block_list.text:
Heading to the cafeteria for lunch,
I spotted Yukino Bijin staring blankly
at the menu board.
choice_data_list: You're looking at that pretty intensely.
You're looking at that pretty intensely.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! 
No, it's not like that...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The limited menu said "Large Soba",
so it just reminded me of the wanko soba back home—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Wanko soba... you say...?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, your hometown is Morioka.
Which means it's the authentic kind............ *gulp*.
choice_data_list: (Her eyes are glaring with intense hunger...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, Oguri!
You're scarin' the pair of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, the mention of wanko soba caught my attention...
Would you mind telling me more?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If you're okay with me telling it...
Though I've only really ever served it before.
choice_data_list: Serving it? As in putting the soba into the bowls?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's really fun~! Tossing in noodles while chanting
"Hai, dondon!" and "Hai, janjan!"—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
At first I wasn't used to it, so the older ladies at the shop
had to help me out constantly, though.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That is wonderful to hear... Does this mean
I can eat wanko soba if I ask you from now on, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Like hell it does!
She just said she only did the servin'!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I can't serve it up myself,
but Morioka's wanko soba is truly delicious!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's plenty of other great food and fun things,
so you definitely ought to visit sometime~.
choice_data_list: Now I really feel like having wanko soba.
Now I really feel like having wanko soba.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's plenty of other great food and fun things,
so you definitely ought to visit sometime~.
choice_data_list: Now I really feel like having wanko soba.
Now I really feel like having wanko soba.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Let's see~. The most famous one
would probably be the "Morioka Sansa Odori" festival!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We parade through the streets together,
beating taiko drums, playing flutes, and dancing!
choice_data_list: Doesn't preparing for that take a lot of work?
Doesn't preparing for that take a lot of work?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If anything, it built up my endurance in lots of ways,
so it was a great experience!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in town treated me like their own grandchild,
so getting ready for it was super fun!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like a lovely hometown.
Was your place like that too, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Tome-san and the others taught me the Kasamatsu Ondo...
I wonder how everyone is doing?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm getting homesick too.
...Maybe I'll write them a letter sometime.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Since I want to send them good news,
I'll have to give training my all!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. And to do that, first
we must fill our bellies properly.

Thoughts of one's hometown
fuel the motivation for training—

Listening to Oguri Cap's rumbling stomach,
I reaffirmed that truth.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What a coincidence, so do I...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's a wanko soba place nearby,
should I show you the way?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The lady who taught me how to serve back home opened it,
so I can guarantee the flavor~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! As delicious as ever,
your soba is the best, ma'am~.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh...
I feel like I could eat this forever...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Whew, so this is authentic flavor.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we're running low on soba.
Ma'am, should I help out?

text_block_list.name: Shop Auntie
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure, Yukino-chan?
Even though you came as a customer...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Leave the serving to me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hai, dondon!
Hai, janjan!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That monster-grade stomach of yours never changes, Oguri.
Even if it's all-you-can-eat, I'm startin' to feel bad for 'em...

text_block_list.name: Shop Auntie
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it~. Having someone eat plenty
and leave satisfied is our greatest joy.

text_block_list.name: Shop Auntie
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much too, Yukino-chan.
You're already a full-fledged server now~.

text_block_list.name: Shop Auntie
text_block_list.text:
Back then you carried trays with such a tiny frame,
everyone watched with their hearts in their throats...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: C-Come on, ma'am, not that story~!

Afterwards, Yukino Bijin kept serving until
Oguri Cap was completely full...
In a sense, it served as great training.
